items.q: What does Utley want from the Churchill bathtub scene?
items.a: An assistant who already has his **context, voice, and intent**. That used to be wartime luxury. **The poorest villager in Palo Alto** can have it now.

items.q: Why did AI make some people *less* creative?
items.a: Underperformers treated it as a **tool** (mediocre → tweak or quit). Outperformers treated it as a **teammate**: coach, feedback, **let it ask you**. Same model. Different orientation.
Studies: ~**25% faster**, **+12% work**, ~**40% quality**. **<10%** of professionals get meaningful gains. Capability is not the bottleneck.

items.q: What did the Glen Canyon ranger do?
items.a: Adam Rymer hated carpet-tile paperwork (2–3 days). Built a natural-language SOW tool in **45 minutes**. NPS estimate: **7,000 days** saved across ~430 parks. Start on work you **dread**.

items.q: What is Utley's favorite definition of creativity?
items.a: A seventh-grader: **doing more than the first thing you think of.** Satisficing / Einstellung. AI makes good-enough cheap. World-class still needs **volume, variation, and sort time**.

items.q: Why do two people get different ChatGPT output?
items.a: Same model. **What you bring**: technique, experience, perspective, and disciplined inspiration (Lecrae: **inspiration is a discipline**). You don't *use* AI. You **work with it**.
